producer: Independent user-interactive serial dispatch timer; immutable event templates copied per send. Planned send time, actual send time and producer delay are separate. Handler-time window context is authoritative; start context is retained separately. Coalesced timer firings retain every planned event ID. No main-thread sender or test event pump.
scope: Dedicated AppKit application using NSApplication.run; generated CGEvent.postToPid keyboard/mouse/window-resize events -> native NSResponder -> CAMetalDrawable.presentedTime. Actual GPU completion is recorded separately as substitute evidence when presentedTime is zero. Zero presentedTime stays null and is never an onscreen presentation claim. No synthetic test event pump, search-result mocks, global keystroke contents or privileged metrics.
windowserver_scope: ScreenCaptureKit captures this process's own visible window only, queueDepth=2. Decode its 16 black/white generated event-ID bars; associate only complete frames carrying that exact ID and displayTime >= input time. displayTime is the WindowServer frame display timestamp (mach absolute time converted using mach_timebase_info). No image, other application content, or global input is retained. This is a compositor observation, not a physical monitor scanout fence. Metal presentedTime remains separate.
